capabilities: Browse notes, images, and videos in a masonry gallery
Filter the gallery into documents and media
Show note titles, tags, excerpts, and cover images on cards
Search by filename and sort by newest or oldest
Select which top-level folders the gallery scans
extras: Not yet accepted into the official community plugin directory; manual installation via GitHub release is described. Cloud-only files may need downloading by a sync provider before previews work.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer lists files by name only, so there is no visual way to browse notes and media as image cards.
summary: Masonry gallery view that browses Markdown notes, images, and videos in a vault with filters, search, and sorting.
